rule: each certification in {CFA, CFP, CIMA, None}; 'None' is a real value
ZIP first digit belongs to the state (USPS areas)
in-window client's first snapshot AUM within 0.5x-2x of initial_aum
calendar attributes agree with date (ISO week)
fixed-date market holidays (Jan 1, Jul 4, Dec 25 on weekdays) are not trading days
note: floating NYSE holidays are not tested; calendar flag behaves like 'weekday'

rule: sector blank if and only if ETF
expense_ratio_bps blank if and only if non-ETF
fee dated the 1st of the month (monthly grain)

note: formula inferred from the data (monthly charge of an annual bps rate); not documented

rule: year and month agree with snapshot_date
aum within 1/3x-3x of the client's previous month
client has a known risk profile (benchmark assignment meaningful)

note: assumes one advisor per client for the whole period (no history table)

rule: amount > 0 for every type (direction comes from txn_type)
Buy/Sell/Dividend have security_id, shares and price
Deposit/Withdrawal/Advisory Fee have blank security_id, shares and price
Dividend amount is a payout, not the full position value (amount != shares x price)
no Sell takes an in-window client's position below zero
no Buy/Sell on an already-negative position (in-window)
first oversell, pre-window client (purchases may predate extract)
Buy/Sell on negative position, pre-window client
dividend only after a recorded purchase (in-window clients)
Deposit/Withdrawal/Advisory Fee dated on a weekday
note: cash movements may be booked on weekends

rule: transaction not after the client's last snapshot month
note: last snapshot is a proxy for departure; no departure date exists

rule: is_post_departure_txn = 1 exactly for txns after the last snapshot month
